app.name: Home Utilities
app.tagline: Bills in, totals out, everyone knows their share.

hints.householdName: Shown at the top of every screen and on the wall display.
hints.splitMode: You can change this later in Settings.
hints.fiscalYearStartMonth: Annual totals run from this month. July for an Australian financial year, January for a calendar year.
hints.pin: 4–8 digits. Used to log in on any device.
hints.activeFrom: Bills before this date won’t include you. A rough date is fine.

shared.label: Shared house
shared.body: Split each bill between housemates and track who has paid.

single.label: Single household
single.body: Just track totals and trends. No splitting.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use Google or get a one-time code by email. No password to remember.

errors.google: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again, or use a code by email.
errors.googleOff: Google sign-in isn't set up on this server yet. Use a code by email.
errors.lockedOut: Too many wrong PINs, so this device was signed out. Sign in again to continue.
errors.rateLimited: A code was sent a moment ago. Wait a minute before asking for another.
errors.emailFailed: The code email couldn't be sent: {reason}
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts from your network. Wait a while and try again.

demo.title: Try the demo household
demo.body: Fictional data for showing the app. Pick a person; the PIN is on the demo sheet.

bills.title: Bills
bills.deleteConfirm: Delete this bill and its shares? This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No bills yet
empty.body: Add your first bill by hand, or wait for the mailbox to pick one up once ingestion is set up.
empty.noServices: Create a service first, then add bills against it.

shares.title: Shares
shares.payerNote: {name} pays the provider; everyone else pays {name} back.
shares.none: No members were active during this billing period.

form.lockedNote: A housemate has already paid their share, so the amount, period and service are locked. Delete and re-enter the bill if they are wrong.
form.externalRefHint: Optional. Stops the same bill being added twice.

bills.searchResults: {count, plural, =0 {No bills match} one {# bill matches} other {# bills match}} “{q}”

alert.payment_failedBody: {provider} emailed on {date} to say the payment for this bill didn't go through. It's no longer marked as paid to them.
alert.overdueBody: {provider} emailed on {date} to say this bill is overdue.

empty.title: No services yet
empty.body: A service is one thing you pay for: internet, electricity, gas, water, rent. Bills belong to services.

types.title: Service types
types.body: Built-in types cover the usual utilities. Add your own for anything else (cleaning, streaming, strata).
types.label: New type

form.name: Name
form.isActive: Active (uncheck when you cancel this service)
form.payerHint: Their own share is marked paid automatically and the others pay them back.
form.trustedSendersHint: Email domains (provider.com.au) or exact addresses whose signed bills are added automatically. Personal mailbox domains like gmail.com can only be added as a full address. Bills forwarded by household members are always accepted.
form.autoPay: Paid automatically (card on file or direct debit)
form.autoPayHint: Bills count as paid to the provider once their due date passes, unless the provider says a payment failed. Turned on by itself when an invoice shows automatic payment.

members.title: Members
members.singleNote: This is a single household, so bills are not split. Members can still log in.
members.deleteConfirm: Delete this member? If they already have bill shares, set a move-out date instead.

form.name: Name
form.newPinHint: Leave blank to keep the current PIN.
form.activeFromHint: Shares are pro-rated from this date.
form.activeToHint: Leave blank if they still live here.
form.splitWeightHint: Used when a service splits by weight. 1 = a normal share, 2 = double.
form.paymentDetails: How to pay this member back
form.paymentDetailsHint: Shown to housemates on bills this member pays. PayID, BSB and account, IBAN, Venmo, anything.
form.emailHint: Optional. An invitation is sent here so they can sign in and choose their own PIN.

invite.title: Invite {name}
invite.body: {name} signs in with Google or an emailed code, then sets their own PIN. The link and code work once, for 7 days.
invite.emailHint: We'll email the invitation. You can also copy the link or code below and send it any way you like.
invite.emailFailed: The email couldn't be sent ({reason}). Copy the link instead.
invite.notShown: The link and code are only shown right after an invitation is created. Send a new invitation to get fresh ones; the old ones stop working.

removeAccess.confirm: Remove {name}'s access? Their bills and shares stay; they can no longer sign in to this household.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.body: {count, plural, one {# browser is} other {# browsers are}} signed in as {email}.
devices.confirm: Sign out every other browser? They'll need Google or an emailed code to get back in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change these.

hints.splitMode: Switching to single stops new bills being split. Existing shares are kept.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.body: Applies to this browser or device only. Auto follows the device setting.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body: This household is the fictional demo. Exiting deletes every demo member, service and bill on this server and opens the setup wizard for your real household. Demo data will not be re-created, even with DEMO_MODE still set.
demo.confirm: Delete the demo household and start real setup? This cannot be undone.

update.title: Software update
update.available: {count, plural, one {# update available} other {# updates available}}
update.howItWorks: The NAS snapshots your data, downloads the new version and restarts the app. It's back in about two minutes.
update.confirm: Update now? The app restarts and is unavailable for about two minutes.
update.unconfigured: Update checks need UPDATE_REPO and UPDATE_GITHUB_TOKEN. You can still install the latest release.
update.queued: Update requested. Waiting for the NAS to pick it up (within a minute)…
update.applying: The NAS is downloading and installing the update…
update.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Check the updater cron job and update.log on the NAS.

empty.title: Nothing to show yet
empty.body: Add your first bill and the dashboard fills in: monthly totals, your share, upcoming due dates and trends.
empty.noServices: Create a service first, then add a bill against it.

overdue.title: {count, plural, one {# overdue bill} other {# overdue bills}}
overdue.by: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

tiles.unpaidShares: {count, plural, one {# unpaid share} other {# unpaid shares}}
tiles.perPersonDayHint: {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} this month

chart.title: Monthly cost by service
chart.hint: Bills spread across the months they cover, so a quarterly bill shows as three months.

ranking.title: Cost by service, {label}
ranking.empty: No bills in this financial year yet.

upcoming.title: Coming up
upcoming.inDays: {days, plural, one {Due tomorrow} other {Due in # days}}

balances.title: Who owes what
balances.owes: Owes {amount} · {count, plural, one {# bill} other {# bills}}

anomaly.title: Unusual bills
anomaly.empty: No unusual bills. Anything far above or below the usual cost per day shows here.

dashboard.reviewBanner: {count, plural, one {# bill needs review} other {# bills need review}}

greetingLine.first: Your first month on the board.

method.seasonal: Seasonal: same month last year, adjusted for drift
method.recent: Average of the last 3 bills per service
method.single: Based on one bill per service so far

reminders.title: Your reminders
reminders.overdue: {count, plural, one {# share overdue} other {# shares overdue}} · {amount}
reminders.soon: {count, plural, one {# share due this week} other {# shares due this week}} · {amount}
reminders.clear: Nothing due from you this week.
reminders.dueIn: {days, plural, =0 {due today} one {due tomorrow} other {due in # days}}
reminders.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

billsTile.title: Bills
billsTile.overdue: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

alertBanner.payment_failed: {provider}: the payment for the bill due {due} failed

unpaid.title: To pay
unpaid.empty: Nothing to pay. You're all square.
unpaid.noPayer: No payer set for this service
unpaid.count: {count, plural, =0 {nothing to pay} one {# share to pay} other {# shares to pay}}

wall.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
wall.dueIn: {days, plural, one {Due tomorrow} other {Due in # days}}

review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: {review} to review · {total} documents archived
review.reprocessAllConfirm: Re-run the extractors over every archived document that isn't already a bill? Existing bills are untouched.

empty.title: Nothing to review
empty.body: Bills that can't be read confidently land here with the file beside a pre-filled form. Upload one to try it.

review.footnote: Every file is kept permanently under the data directory's inbox folder, so a bill can always be re-read later.

detail.noPreview: No text could be read from this file.
detail.alreadyBill: This document already became a bill.
detail.ignoreConfirm: Ignore this document? It stays archived but leaves the queue.

form.noServiceMatch: No service matches "{provider}". Pick one below, or add a service first.
form.trustSender: Trust future bills from {domain} for this service
form.trustSenderHint: The email was signed by its sender, so future bills from {domain} can be added without asking.

upload.title: Upload a bill
upload.subtitleLlm: PDF, HTML or text. Known providers are read instantly; anything else goes through AI extraction.
upload.subtitleNoLlm: PDF, HTML or text. Known providers are read instantly; others land in the review queue because AI extraction is not configured.
upload.fileHint: Up to 25 MB. The file is archived permanently.

tiles.autoRateHint: Bills read without typing, of all documents that needed a decision
tiles.archivedHint: Emails, attachments and uploads kept forever

mailbox.title: Bills mailbox
mailbox.notConfigured: Set IMAP_HOST, IMAP_USER and IMAP_PASSWORD in .env to enable polling.

extractors.title: Extractors (in order)
extractors.threshold: Results below {pct}% confidence go to the review queue.
extractors.aiUsage: AI reads this month: {used} of {limit}. After that, bills no template recognises wait in the review queue until next month.

code.title: Check your email
code.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.

errors.invalid: That code isn't right. Check the latest email and try again.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.too-many-attempts: Too many wrong tries. Send a new code.
errors.noEmail: Start again with your email address.

welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.subtitle: Are you starting a household, or joining one?

create.title: Create a household
create.body: You'll be its admin: add the bills, invite everyone else.

join.title: Join a household
join.body: Enter the code from your invitation, or open the link in the invitation email.
join.invalid: That code doesn't match an open invitation. Check it, or ask for a new one.
join.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a while and try again.

claim.title: Link your existing household
claim.body: This server has a household from before accounts existed. Confirm with its old PIN to link it to {email}.

pin.setBody: Your PIN unlocks the app on devices where you've already signed in. Only you know it; nobody in the household can see or change it.
pin.wrong: Wrong PIN. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left on this device.
pin.notYou: Not you? Sign in as someone else

invite.title: Join {household}

invalid.title: This invitation can't be used
invalid.body: It has expired, was replaced by a newer one, or has already been accepted. Ask the household admin to send a new one.

invite.already: You're already in a household on this server. Joining a second one isn't supported yet.

code.subject: Your sign-in code: {code}
code.intro: Here's your code to sign in to {app}:
code.expiry: It works for 10 minutes. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to {household}
invite.intro: {inviter} invited you to join {household} on {app}, where the household's bills are tracked and split.
invite.codeLine: Or open {url} and enter this code:

billsAddress.title: Bills email address
billsAddress.body: Bills sent to this address are added automatically. If a provider says a payment failed or a bill is overdue, the bill is flagged.
billsAddress.label: Your household's address
billsAddress.howProvider: Easiest: in each provider's online account, change the email address bills are sent to.
billsAddress.howForward: Or forward a bill here from your own inbox whenever one arrives.
billsAddress.howReview: Emails that aren't bills (password resets, plan changes) are kept and, if you turn it on, forwarded to you — they don't need anything from you.
billsAddress.replaceConfirm: Replace the address? The current one stops working immediately, so update any provider that uses it.
billsAddress.short: Bills can also be emailed to {address}
billsAddress.howForwardToMe: Want provider emails (like password resets) in your own inbox too? Turn on forwarding on your member page.
billsAddress.howTrust: Bills from your providers are added the moment they arrive. Only an email that can't be proven to come from the provider waits for a quick look.

forward.title: Forward emails to me
forward.body: Get a copy of what arrives at {address}: password resets and account notices from providers, and bills. Replies go straight back to the provider.
forward.emailHint: Your sign-in email works straight away. Any other address gets a confirmation link first.
forward.pending: Check {email} for a confirmation link. Nothing is forwarded until it's confirmed.
forward.confirmIntro: {member} asked to receive copies of email sent to {household}'s bills address at this address.
forward.confirmIgnore: The link works for 3 days. If this wasn't you, ignore this email and nothing will be forwarded.

confirmPage.title: Confirm forwarding
confirmPage.body: Send copies of {household}'s bills email to {email}?
confirmPage.done: Done. Emails to the bills address will now be copied to this address.
confirmPage.invalid: This confirmation link has expired or was already used. Set forwarding up again from your member page.

forward.banner: Forwarded from your household's bills address {address}. Sent by {sender}.

notify.footer: You get these because you're in {household}. Stop {category}: {url}

newBill.subject: New {service} bill: your share is {share}
newBill.intro: A new {service} bill from {provider} has arrived: {amount} for {period}.
newBill.share: Your share is {share}. Please pay {payer} by {due}.
newBill.payer: You pay {provider} {amount} by {due}. The others owe you {owed} between them.

due.subject: Reminder: your {service} share of {share} is due {when}
due.intro: Your share of the {service} bill ({share}) is due {when}. Please pay {payer}.
due.introNoPayer: Your share of the {service} bill ({share}) is due {when}.

overdue.subject: Overdue: your {service} share of {share}
overdue.intro: Your share of the {service} bill ({share}) was due {due} and hasn't been marked paid. Please pay {payer}, then mark it paid in the app.
overdue.introNoPayer: Your share of the {service} bill ({share}) was due {due} and hasn't been marked paid.

providerDue.subject: Reminder: pay {provider} {amount} by {due}
providerDue.intro: The {service} bill ({amount}) is due to {provider} on {due} and isn't marked as paid yet. Once it's paid, mark it paid to the provider in the app.

alert.subject_overdue: Overdue: {provider} says the {service} bill is unpaid
alert.intro_payment_failed: {provider} says the payment for the {service} bill ({amount}, due {due}) didn't go through. Please check the payment method and pay it.
alert.intro_overdue: {provider} says the {service} bill ({amount}, due {due}) is overdue.

unsubscribe.title: Stop these emails?
unsubscribe.body: {member} will stop getting {category} from {household}. You can turn them back on from your member page.
unsubscribe.done: Done. You won't get these emails any more.
unsubscribe.invalid: This link isn't valid any more.

prefs.title: Email me about
prefs.reminders: Reminders before and after my share is due
prefs.noEmail: You'll need to join with an account before emails can be sent to you.

serviceCreated.subject: New service: {service} ({provider})
serviceCreated.intro: A bill from {provider} arrived, so {service} was set up as a new service and the bill was added.
serviceCreated.check: Please check who pays it (currently {payer}) and how it's split between everyone.
